data.design: H01/H02/H03 x SA/SB x fast/slow; same geometry-only pose sequence within each House

evaluation_scope.authoritative_next_gate: House01/02/03 x seed0/1, full 300 simulation seconds, PMFS ExpectedValue(sourceProbability,0.05) localization error

source_blind_scale_stress_100_seeds.transform: independent per-episode positive scale a in [0.1,10], log-uniform, deterministic source-blind seed

source_blind_monotone_stress_200_seeds.transform: independent per-episode g(c)=log1p(alpha*max(c,0))/alpha, alpha log-uniform [1e-2,1e4], deterministic source-blind seed

ranking_safety_correction.rejected_rule: candidate-wise sign guard followed by per-candidate 1:1 affine/order averaging
ranking_safety_correction.rejection_reason: preserving each candidate score sign does not guarantee preservation of ordering between source hypotheses

current_rule.concordance: C = mean_{i<j} sign(q_aff_i-q_aff_j) sign(q_ord_i-q_ord_j), ignoring ties and candidates with insufficient order support

ranking_safety_correction.guarantee: the local-order channel may attenuate or abstain but cannot reverse affine candidate ordering because the same non-negative scalar multiplies all candidates
